questions.question: Two solid hemispheres of radii 3 cm and 6 cm respectively are melted and recast into a single larger solid hemisphere. What is the approximate total surface area of the newly formed hemisphere?
questions.questionHtml: Two solid hemispheres of radii 3 cm and 6 cm respectively are melted and recast into a single larger solid hemisphere. What is the approximate total surface area of the newly formed hemisphere?
questions.solution:
Volume remains same:

R³ = 3³ + 6³
R³ = 27 + 216 = 243
R ≈ 6.24 cm

Total surface area of hemisphere = 3πR²

= 3 × 3.14 × 6.24 × 6.24
≈ 366.8 cm²

Answer: 367 cm² approximately

questions.questionHtml: A right circular cone is cut into two parts by a plane passing through its mid-height parallel to its base. What is the ratio of the volume of the smaller cone (the top section) to the volume of the original cone?
questions.solution:
At mid-height, the smaller top cone is similar to the original cone.

Linear ratio = 1 : 2

Volume ratio = 1³ : 2³ = 1 : 8

questions.question: Which of the following is the smallest? ∛4, √2, ⁶√15
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following is the smallest?

∛4, √2, ⁶√15
questions.solution:
LCM of 3, 2 and 6 = 6

So, take 6th power of all values:

(∛4)⁶ = 4² = 16

(√2)⁶ = 2³ = 8

(⁶√15)⁶ = 15

Now compare:

16, 8, 15

Smallest value is 8, so the smallest number is √2.

questions.question: Rational number × Irrational number (non-zero) = ?
questions.questionHtml: Rational number × Irrational number (non-zero) = ?
questions.solution:
2 × √3 = 2√3

Here, 2 is rational and √3 is irrational.

So, 2√3 is also irrational.
